changelog: Playback now survives swiping the app from recents, including while the song is paused
The media session, queue and notification stay alive in the background instead of closing
Added Like and Shuffle actions to the lockscreen and notification media controls
The notification heart updates instantly and writes likes back to YouTube Music when signed in
The player seekbar now has an animated wave that freezes while paused
Now Playing and Lyrics follow light, dark and dynamic color themes instead of forcing a dark background
